definitions.gloss: slipping and falling down a slope; sliding down
definitions.explanation: Losing one's footing and falling or sliding down a steep slope or cliff. Commonly used in the context of mountain climbing accidents.

examples.japanese: ⟦{登山者|とざんしゃ}→登山者：21318_tozansha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{斜面|しゃめん}→斜面：12870_shamen⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{滑落|かつらく}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A climber slipped and fell from the slope.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{滑|すべ}らせて→滑る：01230_suberu⟧{滑落|かつらく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Accidents of slipping on snow and falling are common.

examples.japanese: ⟦{約|やく}→約：09563_yaku⟧200⟦メートル→メートル：02975_meetoru⟧{滑落|かつらく}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{奇跡的|きせきてき}→奇跡的：28181_kisekiteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{軽傷|けいしょう}→軽傷：16546_keishou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{済|す}んだ→済む：01950_sumu⟧。
examples.english: He fell about 200 meters but miraculously escaped with only minor injuries.

notes:
USAGE:
Primarily used in mountain climbing and hiking contexts. Frequently appears in news reports about accidents in the mountains. The word implies an uncontrolled slide or fall down a steep terrain, which can be extremely dangerous.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {滑落|かつらく}⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧ (fall accident)
- {滑落|かつらく}⟦{死|し}→死：13248_shi⟧ (death from a fall)
- ⟦{斜面|しゃめん}→斜面：12870_shamen⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{滑落|かつらく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to fall from a slope)
- {滑落|かつらく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧ (to prevent slipping and falling)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{転落|てんらく}→転落：19790_tenraku⟧: falling down — broader, includes falling from buildings or structures
- ⟦{落下|らっか}→落下：14051_rakka⟧: falling, dropping — general falling motion
- ⟦{転倒|てんとう}→転倒：14303_tentou⟧: falling over, tripping — on flat ground, not slopes
